properties.name: Nahm
properties.address: 16/9, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: OP's best family dinner of the trip, mentioned in the original post as the benchmark. Waterfront setting with a sunset view; minimum spend applies for the table right on the water.

properties.name: The Page
properties.address: Chaweng, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: OP's actual pick after this thread — the beef cheek massaman curry with roti recommendation was confirmed as awesome. Beachside restaurant inside a minimalist design hotel on Chaweng beach.

properties.name: Bondi Aussie Bar & Grill (Lamai)
properties.address: 124/88 Thanon Had Lamai, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Recommended for really good ribs and steak. Also has a Chaweng branch (169/1, 3 Chaweng Beach Rd) if that's more convenient.

properties.name: Malee Kitchen (Chaweng)
properties.address: 17/58 Moo 3, Chaweng Beach, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Great Thai dishes — commenter specified the Chaweng branch. There's also a well-reviewed Malee Kitchen Fishermans branch in Bophut.

properties.name: Nana Tam
properties.address: 83/25 Thanon Had Lamai, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Described as 'always a queue' — garden setting with a koi pond, tucked just off the Lamai strip.

properties.name: Bao Bao Asian Eatery
properties.address: 203, 4, Tambon Mae Nam, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84330
properties.notes: One-word rec with a fire emoji. Pan-Asian fusion (bao, gyoza, kimchi) rather than straight Thai food, in Mae Nam.

properties.name: The Shack
properties.address: 88/3 Moo 1 Fisherman's Village, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Flagged as 'not so hidden' but recommended anyway, and separately confirmed for good steaks — a steakhouse in Fisherman's Village.

properties.name: Highland Paradise
properties.address: 55/60, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Hilltop viewpoint restaurant recommended alongside dining spots — panoramic island views, a giant swing, and free-roaming chickens and parrots. Steep road up; drive carefully.

properties.name: Jun Hom Seafood
properties.address: 7 3, Tambon Mae Nam, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84330
properties.notes: Holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand distinction. A commenter singled out the Penang curry; reviews also flag the crab curry as intensely spicy — order with that in mind.

properties.name: The Cocoon — Samui Viewpoint
properties.address: 33, 67, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Called a bit of an influencer spot but a fun, not-traditional night out — hilltop 180° views over the island and ocean. Book ahead for a good table.

properties.name: Siam Kitchen — Authentic Thai Soul Food
properties.address: 85, 8 Choeng Mon, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Recommended in the same breath as The Cocoon — a small, elevated menu of authentic Thai specialities in Choeng Mon, more traditional in style.

properties.name: Ran Khang Non
properties.address: 2, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Recommended specifically for the Khao Soi by a commenter flaired as a Chaweng local. Note: the restaurant's actual name is 'Ran Khang Non' — Non is the owner, not a 'no-beef' modifier as the original comment implied. No printed menu; dishes are shown in photos on the wall.

properties.name: 2 Fishes
properties.address: 109, 15, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Part of a local's shortlist of favourites. Waterfront seafood-and-Italian menu near Fisherman's Village; book ahead as tables often have a time limit.

properties.name: Pepenero
properties.address: 4, 5, Tambon Mae Nam, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84330
properties.notes: Listed among a local's go-to favourites — an authentic, fine-dining-leaning Italian spot near Mae Nam/Bophut.

properties.name: Sabienglae, Bang Rak Beach
properties.address: 55, 4, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Local favourite in Bang Rak — fresh seafood picked live from tanks, beachfront setting, good value.

properties.name: Gusto Italiano
properties.address: 73/3 Moo 1 Fisherman Village, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Good Italian food in Fisherman's Village, per two separate commenters — beachfront tables, homemade pasta and wood-fired pizza. Reviews are mixed on value for the price point.

properties.name: Pi Samui Beach Club and Restaurant
properties.address: 24, 84, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Listed among a local's favourites — beach club on a quiet bay near Choeng Mon, live music some nights, good for families.

properties.name: Supattra Thai Dining
properties.address: 32/6 Moo 4 Sanam Bin Road, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: One-word recommendation from a later commenter. Small, thoughtfully curated fine-dining Thai menu near the airport road; the owners walk guests through every dish.

properties.name: Tai Kik
properties.address: 84, Chumchon Chaweng Yai, Soi 13, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Short, well-upvoted rec — cash-only local spot near the Chaweng boxing stadium, popular with locals and expats alike.

properties.name: Khao Hom
properties.address: H366+J7C, Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Called 'unbeatable for local Thai food' by a commenter who says they've never had better. Old-school kitchen, affordable, no tourist frills.

properties.name: Le Steak Frites
properties.address: 32 Thanon Bo Put, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Compared to the famous L'Entrecôte in France — steak, fries, and salad, small focused menu, near Fisherman's Village.

properties.name: Duomo
properties.address: 60/33 Soi Montien House, Chaweng Beach, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Good Italian food in Chaweng — thin-crust pizza and pasta, upper-level prices but consistently well reviewed.

properties.name: Federico's
properties.address: 258, Bandon Hospital Rd, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Called out as the commenter's favourite Italian restaurant — small, owner-run, known for genuine Neapolitan-style pizza.

properties.name: El Gaucho (Fisherman's Village)
properties.address: 51/7 Fisherman's Village, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Good steaks, per the same comment thread as Gusto Italiano and Sabienglae. Waterfront branch with sunset views; there's also a Central Chaweng mall location.

properties.name: La Côte de Bœuf
properties.address: 30/26, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: French restaurant with good steaks — entrecôte with bone marrow and homemade fries gets singled out. Tucked just off the main road in Bo Put.

properties.name: Pizzeria Sorte
properties.address: 105, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: One of a commenter's two favourites on the island. Neapolitan-style pizza with imported dough and mozzarella, wood-fired oven visible from the dining room.

properties.name: Coco Tam's
properties.address: 62, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: The other of that commenter's two favourites, best at sunset. Beanbags on the sand in Fisherman's Village with a nightly fire show — arrive 1–1.5 hours early without a reservation.

properties.name: Izzy's Specialty Coffee
properties.address: Fisherman's Village, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Coffee spot right next to Pizzeria Sorte, loved by the same commenter — homemade drinks, resident dog named Izzy.

properties.name: Cape Fahn (Hue Restaurant)
properties.address: Cape Fahn Hotel, 24, Tambon Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: For something super special — food was very good, but the setting and overall experience at this resort restaurant were rated A+++.

properties.name: Mom's Kitchen
properties.display_name: Mom's Kitchen (เจ๊อิ๋วอาหารตามสั่ง)
properties.address: H398+V9P, Bo Put, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Recommended specifically for the best fried rice. No-frills local favourite right opposite Wat Plai Laem.
